paragraphs.title: Judah Begins the Campaign and the Battle at Bezek

easy.explanation: The Lord said, “Judah shall go up.”
easy.q: Which tribe did the Lord command to go up first against the Canaanites?

easy.explanation: Judah asked Simeon to go with him, and Simeon went with him.
easy.q: Which tribe went with Judah into battle?

easy.explanation: They slew ten thousand men in Bezek.
easy.q: Where did Judah and Simeon defeat the Canaanites and Perizzites?

answers: To know who should fight first
To choose a place to live
medium.explanation: They asked, “Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first?”
medium.q: Why did the children of Israel ask the Lord at the beginning of the passage?

medium.explanation: They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and great toes.
medium.q: What happened to Adonibezek after he fled?

medium.explanation: Adonibezek’s great toes were cut off along with his thumbs.
medium.q: In the KJV, what are “great toes”?

answers: God had requited him for what he had done
challenge.explanation: He said, “As I have done, so God hath requited me.”
challenge.q: What reason did Adonibezek give for his punishment?

challenge.explanation: He mentioned seventy kings whose thumbs and great toes had been cut off.
challenge.q: How many kings said they had gathered their meat under Adonibezek’s table?

answers: The tribes helped one another in battle
challenge.explanation: Judah invited Simeon to fight with him and promised to go with Simeon in return.
challenge.q: What does Judah’s cooperation with Simeon show about the campaign?

easy.explanation: Judah took Jerusalem and set the city on fire.
easy.q: Which city did the children of Judah take and set on fire?
Who took Kirjathsepher, also called Debir?

answers: The upper springs and the nether springs
easy.explanation: Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

answers: To find someone who would conquer it
medium.explanation: Caleb promised Achsah as a wife to the man who smote and took the city.
medium.q: Why did Caleb offer a reward for taking Kirjathsepher?

medium.explanation: She asked for a blessing and also for springs of water.
medium.q: What did Achsah ask her father for after receiving the south land?

medium.explanation: Judah and Simeon completely destroyed Zephath, and it was called Hormah.
medium.q: In the KJV, what does “utterly destroyed” mean in the account of Zephath?

answers: The mountain, the south, and the valley
The seacoast, the wilderness, and Hermon
challenge.explanation: Judah fought in the mountain, the south, and the valley.
challenge.q: Which regions are specifically mentioned among Judah’s conquests?

answers: Benjamin did not drive them out
challenge.explanation: The Jebusites dwelt with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem.
challenge.q: What happened to the Jebusites in Jerusalem?

challenge.explanation: Othniel was the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
challenge.q: What relationship did Othniel have to Caleb?

paragraphs.title: The Capture of Bethel and the Man of Luz

easy.explanation: The house of Joseph went up against Bethel.
easy.q: Which group went up against Bethel?

answers: A man who came out of the city
easy.explanation: The spies saw a man come forth and asked him to show them the entrance.
easy.q: Who showed the spies the entrance into the city?
What name did the man give the city he built?

answers: The way to the king’s palace
medium.explanation: They said, “Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city.”
medium.q: What did the spies ask the man to show them?

answers: They smote the city with the edge of the sword
They built a wall around the city
medium.explanation: They smote the city with the edge of the sword.
medium.q: What did the house of Joseph do after the man showed them the entrance?

answers: To search out or spy upon
medium.explanation: The house of Joseph sent men to spy out Bethel.
medium.q: In this passage, what does “descry” mean?

answers: Help from the king of Egypt
challenge.explanation: The passage says, “The Lord was with them.”
challenge.q: What enabled the house of Joseph to succeed against Bethel?

challenge.explanation: They let go the man and all his family.
challenge.q: What did the house of Joseph do to the man and his family?

answers: The former name of Bethel was Luz, and the man gave that name to his new city
The man changed Bethel’s name to Luz
challenge.explanation: Bethel had formerly been called Luz, and the man called his new city Luz.
challenge.q: What connection did the two cities called Luz have?

paragraphs.title: The Canaanites Remain and Israel Establishes Partial Rule

easy.explanation: Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites in Gezer.
easy.q: Which tribe did not drive out the Canaanites who dwelt in Gezer?

easy.explanation: They put the Canaanites to tribute but did not utterly drive them out.
easy.q: What did Israel do to the Canaanites when Israel became strong?

easy.explanation: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain.
easy.q: Which tribe was forced by the Amorites into the mountain?

answers: They remained in the land and were sometimes made tributaries
They joined the house of Joseph
medium.explanation: The Canaanites continued to dwell in the land, and some became tributaries.
medium.q: What happened to the Canaanites in places where Israel did not drive them out?

answers: The Amorites would not suffer them to come down
They had moved to the south
medium.explanation: The Amorites forced Dan into the mountain and prevented them from coming down.
medium.q: Why could the children of Dan not come down to the valley?

medium.explanation: The Canaanites became tributaries, meaning they were required to pay or serve.
medium.q: In the KJV, what does “tribute” refer to?

answers: They all drove out every inhabitant
They did not drive out all the Canaanites, who often remained as tributaries
challenge.explanation: The passage repeatedly says these tribes did not drive out the Canaanite inhabitants.
challenge.q: What pattern is repeated concerning Manasseh, Ephraim, Zebulun, Asher, and Naphtali?

challenge.explanation: The Amorites became tributaries to the house of Joseph.
challenge.q: What happened after the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed over the Amorites?

answers: Their coast reached from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward
Their coast reached Jerusalem and Hebron
Their coast reached Bethel and Gezer
challenge.explanation: The final verse gives the coast of the Amorites as extending from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
challenge.q: What geographical detail concludes the passage about the Amorites?
